pages.text: The four lasting infusions do not begin in the circle. They begin in the kettle.$(br2)Each source item below uses Redstone Soup as a base, asks a nearby altar for $(bold)4000 power$(/), and prepares the essence needed for one branch of permanent transformation.$(br2)Like the older hidden registry routes, the Otherwhere and Infernal brews also accept their splash-potion twins if that is what you have on hand.

$(bold)Infused Brew Base$(/): the older circle-brew rites begin here. Brew Redstone Soup with Brew of Flowing Spirit, a Creeper Heart, Toe of Frog, Owlet's Wing, and Tongue of Dog for the first base, spending $(bold)3000 altar power$(/).$(br2)If you already have one, brew it again with Brew of Flowing Spirit, Hint of Rebirth, Mandrake Root, Bat Wool, and Wild Bramble to divide it into two.

$(bold)Ghost of the Light$(/): brew Redstone Soup with a Long Invisibility potion, a Long Fire Resistance potion, a Fire Protection Poppet, a torch, and Tongue of Dog.$(br2)This is the source for the Light infusion.

$(bold)Soul of the World$(/): brew Redstone Soup with a Long Regeneration potion, an Enchanted Golden Apple, an Attuned Stone, a Mandrake Root, and a Rowan Sapling.$(br2)This is the source for the Overworld infusion.
$(bold)Spirit of Otherwhere$(/): brew Redstone Soup with a Long Swiftness potion, two Ender Eyes, a Drop of Luck, and Wool of Bat.$(br2)This is the source for the Otherwhere infusion.
$(bold)Infernal Animus$(/): brew Redstone Soup with a Strong Harming potion, a Voodoo Poppet, a Demon Heart, Refined Evil, and a Blaze Rod.$(br2)This is the source for the Infernal infusion.
